cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You checked your watch, so I set mine by it. Twelve-oh-one. Stay while we settle that prophecy about the bell-less tower ringing at noon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sign that we heard silence. We can close this properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Four more minutes, then. I always allow a second check. Stay until the real noon.

reason: Copied time causes premature disproof; B offset forces correct four-minute extension while A claims second-check procedure instead of admitting ignorance.
